svg.title: RDFox scaling: one named graph per document subsection
svg.text: RDFox scaling: one named graph per document subsection
500,000 named graphs · 14,525,277 quads · 15 size points · quad-table-sg-fi vs quad-table-sg-pi
Memory grows sub-linearly (exponent 0.83, R² 0.98), settling near 95 bytes per quad — the shared dictionary amortises as the corpus grows.
4 of 10 queries are constant-time across a 51,876× increase in data, including the provenance lookup the pattern exists to serve (13.9 µs at full size). The other 6 grow sub-linearly.
quad-table-sg-pi used 12% less memory than quad-table-sg-fi and was never slower.
